  • physical education, health training, and self -preservation, while advocating for a child -centered, non
  • fixed curriculum that prioritizes playing and learning through doing, with discipline arising from natural
  • consequences. Nature as the ultimate reality and teacher, Child-centered and instinct-driven curriculum
